title: VDS Adalah Bos (EN ID FR)
style: trilingual deployment anthem, 96 bpm, English Indonesian French rap, deadpan crisis-summary recital, terminal core, world-tropical pad, VDS-is-boss vibe, sync-doctrine flow, gamelan-touched percussion
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Gemini ripped the desktop seventy files deep
Deployment crisis summary three three six keep
Macintosh HD four GB free R2 SSD full
Forty eight days paused the sync pull

[Pre-Chorus — Indonesian]
Disk penuh tidak ada ruang lagi
VDS adalah jalan keluar pagi
(Disk full no more space / VDS is the way out morning)

[Chorus — trilingual]
VDS is boss VDS adalah bos VDS le patron
Frankfurt VPS the only stable run
One forty three GB Desktop bloat to push
The sync moves the line out of the brush

[Verse 2 — English]
Forty seven domains live edge online
The bottleneck local disk pressure spine
The carpet site solved carpenter services AU
Thirteen Pete domains the inventory true

[Bridge — French]
Le VDS est le seul chemin vers la liberté
Quarante huit jours de pause c'est la réalité
(The VDS is the only path to freedom / Forty eight days of pause it's the reality)

[Outro — trilingual]
VDS is boss VDS adalah bos le patron
Frankfurt holds the line until the dawn
